$schema_note: spec v5.1 feature matrix. Base: tools/industry-features.json at client-site-templates 7158230 (identical in multipage-template 0dd07b5). Layout/hero ids from tools/design.mjs; aliases from tools/mockup.mjs TRADE_ALIASES + tools/library.mjs CATEGORIES/EXTRA_ALIASES at 7158230.

failOn: unknown trade with any money/feature beyond fallback.allowed
features.forbidden includes pricing on every trade (override only via --allow-feature pricing + --allow-reason + --pricing-file)
page has no trade record (pageTradeRecord) in export/CI builds
warnOn: any id not in this trade's allowed or forbidden lists
money default overridden by an allowed non-default value
data file present for a forbidden feature (e.g. menu in content/sample.json on non-food trade)
rules.override: --allow-feature <id> with --reason TEXT downgrades one fail to a warning and is logged in the build output

noPrices.alsoForbidden: price text in money/menu output is governed by menu-file / package data only; templates never print sample prices

hvac.label: heating & cooling
hvac.note: booking allowed only as maintenance-visit scheduling add-on

pest-control.label: pest control
pest-control.note: schema @type LocalBusiness (PestControl is not a schema.org type)

dental-medical.label: dental & medical
dental-medical.note: button label "Request a Visit"; portal off; no health details in forms

law-accounting.label: law & accounting
law-accounting.note: consultation request; multipage uses book, client-site-templates uses quote-form — both allowed

church.label: church
church.note: no money feature; schedule = service times

restaurant.label: restaurant & food truck
restaurant.note: pickup-order needs --menu-file; without it build falls back to menu + call (NOT quote-form)

fallback._applies_to: any trade id not in trades (including unknown aliases resolved to generic-business by --trade typo)
fallback.label: unknown trade

auditMarkers._note: Per id. A page leaks when a marker matches and its id is not allowed for the page trade (money.allowed, features.allowed, layouts.allowed, heroes.allowed, multipage.action/allowedFeatures). Patterns are JS RegExp sources, case-sensitive unless (?i) is noted in flags.

layouts._note: Layouts leave no unique markup; read meta x-layout (pageTradeRecord). Pattern below.

legacyGroups._note: Not part of the spec v5 matrix: HTML patterns used by npm run audit:industry. A marker is a leak when none of its ids is allowed (money.allowed or features.allowed) for the page trade.

pageTradeRecord._note: Every built page records its trade so audits never infer it. Readers use this precedence; the first hit wins, and a conflict between two present sources is a FAIL.

buildJson.file: build.json (next to index.html, or in a parent up to 4 levels)

manifest.note: Backfill for the 358 existing prospects; entries for the 20 flagged wrong-trade prospects record the trade they were BUILT with plus suggestedTrade, until William approves rebuilds.

pageTradeRecord.missing: warn in local builds; FAIL in export-client and CI

aliases._note: Replaces TRADE_ALIASES (mockup.mjs) + LOOSE_SKIP. Keys are resolved trade ids (folder ids). resolveTrade(raw): slugify, then rules in order.
aliases._looseSkipNote: Words never used for loose (token) matching. First 12 = LOOSE_SKIP at 7158230; the rest are added in v5.1 because they are too short/generic to pick a trade from a business NAME (still fine as an exact --trade value). roof/paint/fence remain matchable via their longer aliases (roofing, painting, fencing) and keywords below.
aliases._keywordsNote: Strong trade words. If a business name (not --trade) contains a keyword of a different trade than the one resolved, WARN "name suggests <trade>". Example: "Fresh Coat Painting" resolved to handyman.

priority._note: Tie-break when several trades match loosely: higher wins. Specific trades 100; umbrella trades lower so they never beat a specific match.

tieBreak: 1. exact alias match on the whole slug wins (aliases.exact).
2. reusedNames map to their folder (cleaning -> cleaning-service, restaurant-foodtruck -> restaurant).
3. multi-word aliases (containing "-") found as a substring: longest alias wins.
4. single-token aliases not in looseSkip: candidate trades scored by priority, then by alias length, then by earliest token position in the slug.

5. still tied: WARN and use the first by priority order; never silently prefer insertion order (today's behaviour: handyman beats painting for "painting-and-remodeling" because handyman is listed first).
6. no match: fallback (deny by default) and WARN; never resolve to restaurant via loose match (restaurant needs an exact alias).
aliases._exactOnlyNote: These trades are never chosen by loose token match (avoids "bar", "spa", "studio", "law" in unrelated names).
